restoration_note: This teaching describes the Living Spirit handing the work of ongoing purification to the King of Honor's wheels, the casting-down of the dragon-Error, and the fashioning of the zodiacal sphere by Hyle's enthumesis to perform three permanent providential works: winnowing, restraining (the Holder principle as iron peg), and gathering (the sea as pandocheion). Editor restorations across this technical apparatus are nearly all confirmed by formula, parallelism, and split-word continuations across line breaks. Pure lacunae cluster in three areas: (1) line-end verbal/connective fragments that I conservatively mark unrestorable; (2) the 'ⲛⲑⲉ ___ ⲛⲡⲧⲁⲩ' phrase (gap 3), where 'faces of the four' fits the lexicon's 'four faces of Darkness'; (3) gap 16 'one body, one ___' echoing the immediately preceding 'one icon of many seals,' fixing 'one likeness/icon'; (4) gap 27 with one missing letter between visible ⲡⲕⲁⲣ-ⲝ̄ giving ⲡⲕⲁⲣⲁⲝ (palisade-pole/stake). The closing lines (44–46) describing the establishment of the sea's purification are too damaged for honest restoration.
